# 1 Chip Integrated Software Calibrated CMOS Pressure Sensor

## SUMMARY

This paper reports the newly developed 1 chip integrated CMOS pressure sensor.

## INTRODUCTION

The increasing need for accurate sensors is driving development.

### SYSTEM CONFIGURATION

The device has piezoresistive pressure sensor and temperature sensor.

## FABRICATION PROCESS

Die fabrication process is based on double polysilicon single metal CMOS.
